<?php
function zero_ctrl6($formal = 13) {
    declare(ticks=0);
    $formal = 99;
    $andRight = 0;
    $orRight = 0;
    $and = func_num_args() && ($andRight = 1);
    $or = \func_num_args() || ($orRight = 2);
    echo "BRANCH|", (int)$and, "|", $andRight, "|", (int)$or, "|", $orRight, "|";
    return $formal;
}
$value = zero_ctrl6();
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";

$value = extra_ctrl6(3, 7);
